syncs.description: Make merit cycle employee records available with parent cycle context, names, eligibility, currency, and dynamic compensation-planning columns. A record is identified by its meritCycleId and cycle employee id together.
syncs.name: sync-merit-cycle-employees

id.description: Opaque merit cycle employee ID; record identity is this ID together with meritCycleId, not email.

email.description: Employee email text, preserved as reported.

name.description: Column display name, retained independently of the map key.

type.description: Provider column type such as text, number, currency, boolean, or composite; unfamiliar types remain intact.

value.description: Native JSON column value preserving scalar types and structured composite or currency objects; nested currency objects retain code and value members.

additionalProperties.description: A cycle-defined compensation-planning column and its native JSON value.

columns.description: Cycle-defined column keys mapped to column metadata and native structured values; empty maps are preserved.

code.description: ISO 4217 code from source currencyCode.code; omitted if absent.

name.description: Readable currency name from source currencyCode.value; omitted if absent.

currency.description: Employee currency code and readable name; source omissions of nested members are retained.

lastName.description: Employee last name, preserving Unicode and empty strings.

firstName.description: Employee first name, preserving Unicode and empty strings.

meritCycleId.description: Opaque parent merit cycle ID that scopes this employee record.

preferredName.description: Preferred name preserved as ordinary text, null, or an opaque structured object because the source declaration and example disagree.

eligibilityStatus.description: Employee eligibility in this merit cycle, without an inferred reason.

MeritCycleEmployees.description: Merit cycle employee records with parent cycle context, names, eligibility, currency, and dynamic compensation-planning columns.

syncs.description: Make each merit cycle's base currency and exchange-rate table available as a dataset, with one record per cycle.
syncs.name: sync-merit-cycle-exchange-rates

id.description: Opaque merit cycle ID, also the identity of this cycle's exchange-rate-table record.

additionalProperties.description: Numeric exchange rate from the base currency to the currency identified by this key.

rates.description: Target currency codes mapped to provider-reported exchange rates from the base currency; empty maps are preserved.

baseCurrencyCode.description: Base currency reported by Pave for this merit cycle.

MeritCycleExchangeRates.description: A merit cycle's base currency and provider-reported exchange-rate table, identified by the cycle ID.

syncs.description: Make merit cycle identifiers, names, lifecycle statuses, and start, end, and creation instants available as a replicated dataset.
syncs.name: sync-merit-cycles

name.description: Cycle display name, preserving Unicode text.

status.description: Cycle lifecycle status reported by Pave.

startsAt.description: Cycle start instant normalized to UTC Z with fractional precision preserved.

endsAt.description: Cycle end instant normalized to UTC Z with fractional precision preserved.

createdAt.description: Cycle creation instant normalized to UTC Z with fractional precision preserved.

MeritCycles.description: Merit cycle identifiers, names, lifecycle statuses, and start, end, and creation instants.

functions.name: get-merit-cycle
functions.description: Get one merit cycle by its opaque identifier.

meritCycleId.description: Opaque merit cycle ID returned by list-merit-cycles.

FunctionInput_pave_getmeritcycle.description: The opaque identifier of the merit cycle to retrieve.

name.description: Cycle display name as ordinary Unicode text.

endsAt.description: Cycle end instant in UTC with Z, preserving fractional-second precision.

status.description: Cycle lifecycle status reported by Pave.

startsAt.description: Cycle start instant in UTC with Z, preserving fractional-second precision.

createdAt.description: Cycle creation instant in UTC with Z, preserving fractional-second precision.

FunctionOutput_pave_getmeritcycle.description: Merit cycle metadata with timestamps normalized to UTC without losing fractional seconds.

tags.instructions: Use this for a known cycle ID. Obtain IDs with `list-merit-cycles`. Use `list-merit-cycle-employees` for participants or `get-merit-cycle-exchange-rates` for cycle rates; this tool returns cycle metadata only.

functions.name: get-merit-cycle-exchange-rates
functions.description: Get the exchange-rate table relative to a merit cycle's own currency.

meritCycleId.description: Opaque merit cycle ID whose configured exchange-rate table is requested.

FunctionInput_pave_getmeritcycleexchange.description: Identify the merit cycle whose configured exchange-rate table to retrieve.

additionalProperties.description: Provider-reported exchange rate from the base currency to the currency named by this map key.

rates.description: Target-currency code to numeric exchange rate from the base currency, preserving the provider's entries; an empty map means no rates were returned.

meritCycleId.description: Opaque identifier of the cycle to which this table belongs.

baseCurrencyCode.description: Base currency reported by Pave, which is the merit cycle currency.

FunctionOutput_pave_getmeritcycleexchang.description: The complete configured exchange-rate table relative to the requested merit cycle currency.

tags.instructions: Use this for the rates configured for a particular merit cycle, not for a live market quote. Obtain meritCycleId from `list-merit-cycles`. The returned table is a single complete response, with rates keyed by target currency. Use `get-merit-cycle` for cycle metadata.

functions.name: list-merit-cycle-employees
functions.description: List one page of employees in a merit cycle, including eligibility, currency, and dynamic compensation-planning columns.

limit.description: Maximum employees requested in this page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same cycle and connection; omit for the first page.

meritCycleId.description: Opaque ID of the merit cycle whose participants are requested.

FunctionInput_pave_listmeritcycleemploye.description: Request one page of participants in a merit cycle.

id.description: Opaque merit cycle employee ID, not an assumed organization-wide employee ID; interpret in conjunction with meritCycleId.

email.description: Employee email text reported by Pave, preserved without normalization.

name.description: Column display name, which may differ from the containing map key.

type.description: Provider column type, such as text, number, currency, boolean, or composite; retained without imposing a closed enum.

value.description: Native column value, preserving strings, booleans, numbers, nulls, and structured composite or currency objects; currency objects retain their code and value members.

additionalProperties.description: A cycle-defined planning column and its native value.

columns.description: Cycle-defined column keys mapped to their display name, type, and structured value; empty maps remain empty.

code.description: ISO 4217 currency code from the source code member; omitted if absent upstream.

name.description: Readable currency name from the source value member; omitted if absent upstream.

currency.description: Employee currency code and readable name, retaining any source omission of either member.

lastName.description: Employee last name, preserving Unicode and empty strings.

firstName.description: Employee first name, preserving Unicode and empty strings.

meritCycleId.description: Opaque ID of the parent merit cycle.

preferredName.description: Preferred name as reported: ordinary text, null when absent, or an opaque structured object preserved because the provider schema and example disagree.

eligibilityStatus.description: Cycle-specific eligibility status, without inferring an exclusion reason.

items.description: A merit cycle participant with cycle-specific planning data.
Employees in this provider page, including cycle-specific planning data; empty if none are returned.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token for the same cycle; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_pave_listmeritcycleemploy.description: One page of merit cycle employees and its optional continuation token.

tags.instructions: Obtain meritCycleId using `list-merit-cycles`. Use this to browse cycle participants and their planning columns, not to retrieve an organization-wide employee directory. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the same cycle. Limit is 1–100, default 25. Column keys and values are cycle-specific; preserve their type and structure rather than treating every value as text.

functions.name: list-merit-cycles
functions.description: List one page of merit cycles, optionally filtered by lifecycle status and start instant.

limit.description: Maximum cycles requested in this page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous page under this connection and the same filters; omit for the first page.

status.description: Only include cycles with this lifecycle status; omit for all statuses.

startsAt.description: Exact cycle start instant to filter by, with an explicit UTC marker or numeric offset; omit for no start filter.

FunctionInput_pave_listmeritcycles.description: Page size, opaque continuation cursor, and optional merit cycle filters.

id.description: Opaque merit cycle identifier, usable in cycle-specific tools.

name.description: Cycle display name, preserved as ordinary Unicode text.

endsAt.description: Cycle end instant normalized to UTC with Z; fractional-second precision is preserved.

status.description: Cycle lifecycle status reported by Pave.

startsAt.description: Cycle start instant normalized to UTC with Z; fractional-second precision is preserved.

createdAt.description: Cycle creation instant normalized to UTC with Z; fractional-second precision is preserved.

items.description: A merit cycle with opaque identifiers and UTC instants.
Merit cycles in this provider page; empty when no cycles are returned.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token for the next page; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_pave_listmeritcycles.description: One provider page of merit cycles and its optional continuation token.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover cycle IDs and browse cycles. Use `get-merit-cycle` for a known ID, `list-merit-cycle-employees` for participants, and `get-merit-cycle-exchange-rates` for cycle currency conversion rates. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters to continue. Each call returns one page; limit is 1–100, default 25.

functions.name: test-connection
functions.description: Call Pave's authenticated test endpoint and return its response message. Success does not establish access to every compensation-planning resource.

FunctionInput_pave_testconnection.description: No parameters are needed to check the configured Pave API key.

message.description: Text returned by the authenticated test endpoint, typically pong; not a guarantee of permissions for other resources.

FunctionOutput_pave_testconnection.description: The message returned by the authenticated Pave connection check.

tags.instructions: Use this for a lightweight API-key connection check. No resource ID is needed. A successful ping does not prove access to merit cycles or employee compensation data; use `list-merit-cycles` to check cycle access.
